policies.title: Office Timings
policies.content: Standard Shift : 9h 00m - 9:30 AM - 06:30 PM (Shift Timings). Mandatory check-in before 09:30 AM for standard working credits.

policies.title: Attendance Rules
policies.content: Grace Period : 15 mins upto 9:45 AM (Max 3 lates permitted per month). Post 9:45 AM will count directly toward late arrivals.

policies.title: Late Arrival Penalty
policies.content: Late Penalty : 3 Lates = 0.5 Leaves (Deduction applied automatically in monthly payroll reconciliation).

policies.title: Work From Home (WFH)
policies.content: Leave & WFH : Max 4 WFH days & 1.5 Paid leaves per month. Must be requested at least 24 hours in advance.

policies.title: Absence & Leave
policies.content: Half Day Cutoff : 4h 00m (Minimum 4 hours required for half-day credit; less than 4 hours is marked as Absent).
